company.name: Box
company.shortDescription: Box is an online file sharing and cloud content management service offering unlimited storage, custom branding, and administrative controls.
company.description: Box is an online file sharing and cloud content management service offering unlimited storage, custom branding, and administrative controls. Box provides more than 8 million users with secure cloud content management and collaboration. Box platform "allows personal and commercial content to be accessible, sharable, and storable in any format from anywhere." It also helps businesses of all sizes in every industry securely access and manages their critical information in the cloud.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Debt round raised $400,000,000, or 27.42% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 15 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $600,000,000 to $3,571,000,000, a 5.95x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
